purpose: Human-readable progress handoff and pre-work discovery; not an automated scheduler or proof of current live CI state.

workflow_history.note: Historical fixed snapshot, not current status.

readiness_rules: Do not claim completed output without real full-size image, full SHA, and separate independent verification receipt.
Never treat cross-PR successful CI from different head commits as one successful integration.
Inspect the latest PR HEAD and workflow logs before changing a status; null means unknown.
No private binaries, signing material, device operations, or uploaded CI images.

items.verified_scope: Source/synthetic tests and upstream native build evidence only; successful runs must be pinned to their own HEAD.
items.blocking_requirement: One actual pinned public-source package/install rootfs with manifest into the p26 packer, then independent full-tree ownership, symlink, xattr, SquashFS, padding and 128MiB SHA acceptance.
items.next_safe_step: Compare current #127 HEAD with most recent CI, fix the first demonstrated source-catalog error if still present; reuse existing package/install and packer in one job.

items.verified_scope: Image/DTB/source checks are narrower than a complete boot-v2 32MiB image.
items.blocking_requirement: Compatible lawful board kernel + true boot-v2 p25 assembly and a separate full-file readback of the completed unsigned 32MiB output.
items.next_safe_step: Inspect current DTS/DTB PR heads and existing boot layout contracts; close the first concrete assembly input gap without duplicate rebuilding.

items.verified_scope: wpad package/source work is on a separate open PR; its outputs do not automatically appear in the #127 checkout.
items.blocking_requirement: Pinned build input and manifest proving any required LAN/AP packages actually came from the same merged or explicitly combined checkout.
items.next_safe_step: Review actual checked-out workflow blob, package manifest and run SHA before claiming readiness.

items.verified_scope: 648 historical Actions run metadata entries through a fixed cutoff; not all job logs audited.
items.next_safe_step: Keep #128 as workflow-history primary source and #129 as navigation/triage entrypoint; link, do not duplicate the 648-event JSON.

maintenance: Manual snapshot only. Update each item's state with the exact newer PR SHA, Actions run and observed evidence; do not let a dated catalog override newer live findings. This phase does not alter cron or workflows.
